title: Next-session refusal
description: The body of a coded refusal of the control plane to the next-session request, next-session-request.schema.json: Forager's link refusal, https://qory.dev/contracts/forager/v1/link-refusal.schema.json, with from apiary. The gateway passes on the control plane's signed coded refusal with its status, error, names and message, and sets from to apiary. error is one of five codes, and each code has one status: 400 invalid_request, a body outside next-session-request.schema.json, with names, the first member that fails or body for a body that is not a JSON object, and message; 404 not_found, an unknown run, a run of another gateway, a run of Explore, or a run that the control plane does not run as a shared run; 409 run_ended, with message, a run that ended, that a member cancelled, that the stage no longer runs, whose last step returned end, or whose next session has inputs that cannot be formed; 409 session_mismatch, with message, a session lower than the newest session that the run reported; 503 unavailable, the control plane could not complete the request and stored nothing, so the same request can be sent again. names and message are optional here, as in the link refusal. A refusal of the gateway, with from gateway, is not this document. The other members are as the link refusal defines them.

error.description: The code of the control plane's refusal: invalid_request, not_found, run_ended, session_mismatch or unavailable.

from.description: apiary: the gateway passes on the control plane's refusal.
